notes:
nrcan_ceud_transport_provincial: Provincial transport energy, activity and fleet statistics by vehicle class; aggregate series do not identify individual vehicle vintages or technologies.
  - 21: Provincial car stock, sales and distance travelled; fleet totals require separate age and fuel evidence for technology cohorts.
  - 37: Provincial passenger-light-truck, freight-light-truck and medium/heavy-truck fleet statistics; source classes pool vehicle sizes and powertrains.
statcan_transport_tables: Canadian vehicle registrations, freight flows and reported transit-asset useful lives; coverage and statistical concepts differ by table.
  - 20-10-0021-01: Archived annual new-LDV registrations by province, vehicle type and fuel; supplies history before current-table coverage, not the age distribution of surviving stock.
  - 20-10-0025-01: Quarterly new-LDV registrations by geographic level, vehicle type and fuel; complete years are aggregated for historical fuel shares.
dunsky_ev_charging_infrastructure: Canadian LD/MHD charging projections with reviewed port mixes, utilization and equipment/installation costs. Native costs are CAD2022 per rated charging power; final model costs use the scenario currency and price year.
transport_canada_ev_dashboard: Canadian provincial EV market-share and public charging-port snapshots; reporting dates and coverage differ by component.
  - public_light_duty_chargers: Public light-duty charging-port counts by province as of March 2026, with national L2/DCFC shares; provincial counts exclude private chargers.
pollution_probe_ev_charging_survey: Canadian EV-owner survey evidence for private L1/L2 charging, represented by the reviewed private-charger share split.
epa_moves_heavy_truck_survival: MOVES conditional annual car, light-truck and heavy-vehicle schedules proxy Canadian survival. Heavy rates also represent medium trucks; native source ages and underlying evidence vintages are retained.

nrcan_ceud_transport_provincial: Provincial transport energy, activity and fleet statistics by vehicle class; aggregate series do not identify individual vehicle vintages or technologies.
  - 37: Provincial passenger-light-truck, freight-light-truck and medium/heavy-truck fleet statistics; source classes pool vehicle sizes and powertrains.
statcan_transport_tables: Canadian vehicle registrations, freight flows and reported transit-asset useful lives; coverage and statistical concepts differ by table.
  - 23-10-0308-01: Registered vehicle stock by province, weight class and fuel; stock composition is used as a fuel-mix proxy rather than new-vehicle sales.
dunsky_ev_charging_infrastructure: Canadian LD/MHD charging projections with reviewed port mixes, utilization and equipment/installation costs. Native costs are CAD2022 per rated charging power; final model costs use the scenario currency and price year.
transport_canada_ev_dashboard: Canadian provincial EV market-share and public charging-port snapshots; reporting dates and coverage differ by component.
  - medium_heavy_ev_market_share: Provincial MHDV EV market shares for 2026 year to date, used as a stock-share proxy where selected; market share does not directly measure the installed fleet.
epa_moves_heavy_truck_survival: MOVES conditional annual car, light-truck and heavy-vehicle schedules proxy Canadian survival. Heavy rates also represent medium trucks; native source ages and underlying evidence vintages are retained.
